title: Sega Ages: Columns Arcade Collection
native_title: セガエイジス コラムス・アーケード・コレクション
overview:
Enjoy everything Columns has to offer.

Four arcade Columns games come together on one disc. Line up three or more matching jewels vertically, horizontally or diagonally as columns of three fall into the well, and keep the pile from reaching the top.

- Columns - the original falling-jewel puzzle, enjoyed by beginners and experts alike
- Columns II - battle computer opponents in a tournament held in casinos around the world
- Stack Columns - the puzzle-focused, stage-clearing Flash Columns plus a VS mode for two players
- Columns '97 - the original Columns remade with high-resolution graphics, with rank certification

Clear jewels in each game to unlock bonuses, including galleries of the original arcade instruction cards and options that change the look of the gems and the sound effects.

コラムスのすべてが楽しめる
